felix is a terminal user interface (TUI) file manager with Vim-like key mappings.

Usage

  fx [path]

Options

  -h, --help     Print help.
  -l, --log      Launch the app and generate a log file.
  --init         Returns a shell snippet for shell integration.

Key bindings (summary)

  j / <Down>      : Move down
  k / <Up>        : Move up
  <C-d>           : Move down half a page
  <C-u>           : Move up half a page
  h / <Left>      : Go to parent directory
  l / <Right> / <CR> : Open item
  gg              : Go to top
  G               : Go to bottom
  dd              : Delete and yank item
  yy              : Yank item
  p               : Put yanked item(s)
  :q              : Exit
